text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East has 22.3 days of lisinopril 10 mg tablets on hand (279 units) and Corvale General has 22.6 days on hand (317.52 units). Lisinopril is not on the FDA drug shortage list.

Why (FDA record): The product label lists Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004021229) as a registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 684552 of that plant ended on 2010-09-24 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2010-12-23. Subsequent inspections of the same plant from 2011 through 2023 were all classified VAI. The label also names APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (FEI 3011895410) as a registered plant, whose most recent inspection on 2025-12-17 was VAI.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately three weeks of supply. No FDA shortage listing exists. Manufacturing sites show acceptable recent inspection histories.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from A-S Medication Solutions, pending P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Actavis Pharma, Inc., pending P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, pending P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Almatica Pharma Inc., pending P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from American Health Packaging, pending P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
